thread:
sam (release): Heads-up — embeddings QPS dropped ~6% in eu-west1 starting 09:12. Perf triage points at a KV cache eviction hotloop under high churn. Requesting expedited hotfix into current change window (10m).

maya (sre): noted. what's the image/sha and risk if we skip canary? we prefer a short canary if possible.

sam (release): image: gcr.redwood-inference/internal/embed-service:hotfix-2026-03-23@sha256:7b4c9d2. Reasonable to do canary=5% for 2m, but perf flagged noisy traffic shift. If we opt for skip-canary, policy needs 2 approvers + oncall.

jen (oncall): oncall ack. I'll monitor logs/alerts during rollout.

leo (eng): patch reverts the recent aggressive evict heuristic and introduces a guard metric kv_evict_rate. Staging e2e + perf smoke clean. I can sign off for eng.

maya (sre): we need explicit smoke list and rollback thresholds before we greenlight expedited path. Also request a release-note stub and pin-back plan.

sam (release): smoke: 1) /health = 200 2) p50 within baseline + 10ms 3) kv_evict_rate drops below current median. rollback triggers: 1) error-rate increase >2% sustained 90s OR 2) p95 > baseline + 150ms for 2 consecutive minutes. pin-back: deploy previous image sha256:ff99aa00 with rollout id rl-pin-6990023456-prev.

nina (product): FYI customer success flagged a few NA customers seeing degraded embed quality — please include brief note for CS.

leo (eng): +1 ENG. patch verified.

maya (sre): +1 SRE but prefer canary=5% if deploy-bot allows quick rollback automation. otherwise +1 for expedited skip.

sam (release): team decision: proceed with canary=5% for 2m then 25% for 1m then full if healthy. canary flow reduces approval requirements and safer. @deploy-bot prepare rollout with that plan. Release-note: "Hotfix: Fix KV eviction race in embeddings; mitigates transient QPS drop in eu-west1; no expected model behavior changes; CS notified."

releasebot: Deploy request accepted. Plan: canary=5% (2m) -> 25% (1m) -> 100% if smoke passes. Requirements: oncall ack + one approver = satisfied.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollout embed-service -> gcr.redwood-inference/internal/embed-service@sha256:7b4c9d2. Rollout id rl-6990023456-1. Canary 5% for 2m.

jen (oncall): watching logs, enabling temporary silence for non-actionable alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary window 00:30s: small transient 429 spike at +12s, auto-rollback not triggered. Metrics: p50 stable, kv_evict_rate down.

leo (eng): confirming kv_evict_rate metric trend looks good.

maya (sre): canary passed 2m. advancing to 25% for 1m.

deploy-bot: Advancing to 25% -> 1m window started.

jen (oncall): 25% window looks clean. No error uptick.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete -> success. rl-6990023456-1.

sam (release): Good work. Notifying CS with the note. Postmortem action: add canary guard in deploy-bot to auto-hold on 429 spikes >0.5% during canary.

nina (product): CS notified — we included guidance for customers on expected minimal disruption.

leo (eng): I'll open PR for the guard and add a long-term fix ticket.

maya (sre): monitors in watch mode 24h. If regression, we'll pin and roll back immediately. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
